name: Princess Kingdom
release_name: Category button alignment and shorter journal progress bar
changes: Adjusted category dimming and selected-state overlays to use elliptical corner radii that follow the artwork buttons more closely.
Moved the selected orange frame inside the category hit area so it no longer extends beyond the illustrated button.
Shortened and centered the journal progress bar beneath the journal label and total counter.
Preserved category button behavior, challenge selection, offline-first startup, update checks, progress data, and the 600-challenge bank.
